GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Shade slow away. Not pushed early & raced @ rear Two Wide (8L from lead). Stayed @ rear Two Wide midrace & pushed to quicken @ 600m. Chasing 3 Wide @ 500m & pressured Five Wide (7L from lead) on home turn. Pressured & raced tight @ 250m & held ground in last 200m. # Never a chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began only fairly and bumped another runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 Lengths Settled Down 2nd last 6 Lengths 800m 8th rail 6 Lengths home turn Under Pressure last Kept Going Ok Straight # last/only fair late
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: A pre-race veterinary examination of the gelding, which got its off-hind leg up on the barrier running board for a short time, passed it fit to race. Slow to begin.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly & Went Forward to Lead on fence by a head, Headed 1400m, shifted Two Wide after being crossed, moved back up to within 0.75 Lengths turning, Lost Ground in straight. (Nasal Strip FIRST TIME, Winkers FIRST TIME) # weakened in str.
Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 6 Lengths 2-3 wide, little change to 5.5 Lengths Two Wide turning, only Held Ground in Straight # never a threat

Jumped awkwardly missing start 2 Lengths & Settled Down 6 Lengths on fence, railed to 5 Lengths by the 1200m and 4 Lengths rail at the turn, Made Some Ground along fence in straight. [Stewards: Raced IPSW 06/04/2026. Underwent pre-race vet exam. Cleared to start.] # missed start 2L.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Vetted pre-race after having raced at Ipswich 6/4/26. Began awkwardly and lost ground. Laid out approaching and round home turn.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 2 Lengths on fence, held together much same to turn 2.5 Lengths rail, Held Up and laid out rounding turn then Lost Ground in Straight # no real excuses
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid out round home turn. Bumped near the 150m whilst weakening.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 2.5 Lengths on fence, shuffled back to 6.5 Lengths rail turning, Dropped Out in Straight # weakened noticeably
Jumped okay & Settled Down 2.5 Lengths on fence, Drifted Back to 5 Lengths rail turning, Made Some Ground in Straight # battled on fairly
Jumped Ok sat box seat 2 Lengths off, under pressure turn, Straightened Up 3l off, kept on one pace # box seat/leader won
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted out on jumping and bumped another rnr.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 2 lengths Settled Down last 10 lengths. last turn. made some ground # slow away
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped on jumping with a runner. On return to scale rider advised that in his view his mount had not appreciated today’s firm track.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok eased back 8l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up well off, ran on well without threatening # back/ran on well
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: On jumping shifted in and bumped. From a wide barrier was shifted in behind runners in the early stages.
